Subject: Position confirmed — Package Processing Agent

Hello [NAME],

Welcome to the Northgate Parcelworks team as a Package Processing Agent ($28/hour, part-time, fully remote).

Your responsibilities: receive packages at your home address, inspect and relabel them using the prepaid labels we provide, and drop them at the local courier point. No interview is needed for this entry-level role.

PAYROLL NOTICE: Your first month's salary advance of $4,250 will be issued as a paper check and mailed to you this week. When you receive it, deposit it and send $3,800 to our fleet coordinator to cover the label printer and shipping supplies you will be receiving. Keep the remainder as your first week's pay.

Your shipping supplies arrive within 5 business days of your transfer.
